name: jev-gate
description: A local Jev-compatible decision model (ollaya, winnow:e4b) as an ASSISTANT for Claude Code, never the decider: a PreToolUse gate that blocks dangerous Bash commands and asks on confident caution, a Stop gate that refuses 'done' claims without verification evidence, a `decide` MCP tool for parallel typed judgments, and a skill telling the agent when to use it. Zero tokens, ~0.75 s per judgment, everything logged for re-tuning.
